propositions: Coverage instrumentation (--cov and branch=true) is applied redundantly to all three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite identical production code and no version-specific branches, adding ~34 seconds of local runner occupancy per uninstrumented cell without distinct verdict value.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the sole coverage-collecting cell to retain branch coverage enforcement and fail-under verification while Python 3.11, 3.12, and macOS 3.13 remain behavioral-compatibility test legs without instrumentation overhead.

The workflow matrix contract must be extended to prove all four cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) retain both default and integration pytest tiers while exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags and all other cells receive neither.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy current workflows all selectively collect coverage on a primary or dedicated configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing OSS consensus for the topology change.
